phase: Phase 6 - Stocks Tab (StockDetailModal - 13 Tabs & Child Modals) AI & Quantitative Stress Audit

criticalFindings: STK-TEST-01..06: Instant Buy Calculator omits the Rs. 25 DP fee from Total Cost Payable while displaying it in the 'SEBON Fee + DP' line item (line items do not sum to Total Cost Payable).

STK-TEST-08: Instant Buy Calculator accepts negative quantity (-100 shares) and computes negative Gross Turnover (Rs. -34,390), negative SEBON fee + DP (Rs. 19.84 = -5.16 + 25), and negative Total Cost Payable (Rs. -34,395.16).

STK-TEST-13..14: AI Guru Live Report ignores the active Order Flow Veto ('Whale Dump: Nagarik Stock Dealer dumped 33.14% of total session volume') and outputs '⚪ CAUTIOUS ZONE (BELOW 20 EMA) — Wyckoff Cycle Phase B: Absorption & Cause Building', contradicting both Overview Veto Law and Technicals Tab ('Phase D: Distribution / UTAD').
STK-TEST-18: Overview Rupee Investment Simulator accepts negative rupee input (-50,000) without clamping to 0.
STK-TEST-22: Compare Peers Tab allows comparing AKJCL against itself (AKJCL vs. AKJCL) without warning or filtering out the base symbol.

STK-TEST-23..25: Compare Peers Tab silently ignores non-existent symbols ('ZZZZZZ'), Nepali Devanagari ('आँखुखोला'), and invalid queries without showing a 'No matching stock found' message (leaves previous peer AHL on screen).
